mapper.sql: id, task_name, title, body, button_text, push_type, required_read, push_pages, internal_url, target_url, external_url, banner_url, audience_type, audience_file_name, clear_target_ids, notes, status, status_message, total_count, success_count, failure_count, cleared_at, published_at, send_completed_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM push_task WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM push_task WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY published_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM push_task t WHERE t.push_type IN ('internal', 'all') AND t.required_read = 1 AND t.cleared_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM push_display_log d WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND d.task_id = t.id ) AND ( t.audience_type = 'all' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM push_task_audience a WHERE a.task_id = t.id AND a.resolved_user_id = #{userId} ) ) ORDER BY t.published_at ASC, t.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE push_task SET status = 'SENDING' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'

UPDATE push_task SET status = 'COMPLETED', total_count = #{totalCount}, success_count = #{successCount}, failure_count = #{failureCount}, send_completed_at = #{completedAt, typeHandler=com.pk.infra.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler} WHERE id = #{id}
